name: Banihal Qazigund Road Tunnel
facts: Banihal Qazigund Road Tunnel, 8.45 km long, opened in August 2021, cuts the Banihal Pass by 16 km, slashing Srinagar‑Jammu travel time from six hours to five and a half.
Each of the tunnel’s twin tubes is 7 m wide, houses two lanes, and connects to a maintenance passage every 500 m, equipped with 126 jet fans, 234 CCTV cameras, and a firefighting system.
Built at ₹2,100 crore on a build‑operate‑transfer basis, the tunnel sits 400 m lower than the old Jawahar tunnel, dramatically reducing avalanche risk at 1,790 m elevation.
